CustomField.description: Boolean depth formula using `ISBLANK(Parent[.Parent...].ParentId)`. Depth ≥ 5 is clamped at 5. Use in list-view filters and reports to isolate leaf-level campaigns versus category branches.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. Depth of this campaign in the hierarchy — 1 for top-level campaigns with no parent, 2 for direct children, up to 5 for the deepest supported nesting.
CustomField.label: Hierarchy Depth
